title: Decide which side may remain authoritative
description: Inject a cluster incident, then change the state model and protection controls. The result separates copy survival, split-brain consistency, and client-cache freshness.

scenarios.label: Two members fail before safety is rebuilt
scenarios.detail: Primary and backup ownership may disappear together while the cluster is still migrating partitions.

scenarios.label: The member network splits into two sides
scenarios.detail: Clients can still reach both sub-clusters, so availability and one-authority guarantees conflict.

scenarios.label: A client misses an invalidation window
scenarios.detail: The cluster map changes while a client retains an older local Near Cache copy.
